elements.label: HubSpot wordmark
elements.change_other: assemble from scattered dots and stroke fragments that grow and join into the letterforms

pattern.description: The HubSpot wordmark builds itself from scattered dots and short strokes that grow and lock into the letterforms on a flat brand-orange field; a faint 'Customer Platform' line and rounded corner shapes ease in as it settles.
pattern.why_premium: The logo is built from its own geometry (the sprocket dots) instead of a plain fade, so the brand mark reads as designed motion in about half a second, and the faint secondary elements add depth without pulling focus.

build_hint.gsap: Split the logo into SVG parts (dots, stems, bowls). gsap.fromTo(parts, {scale:0, opacity:0, transformOrigin:'50% 50%'}, {scale:1, opacity:1, duration:0.35, ease:'back.out(1.4)', stagger:{each:0.015, from:'random'}}); overlap with stroke growth on stems (scaleY 0 to 1, ease 'power3.out'). Then at +0.3s gsap.fromTo('.tagline', {opacity:0}, {opacity:0.15, duration:0.25, ease:'power2.out'}) and gsap.fromTo('.corner-shape', {yPercent:30, opacity:0}, {yPercent:0, opacity:1, duration:0.3, ease:'power2.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: Per logo part: spring({frame: frame - delay_i, fps, config:{damping:14, stiffness:180, mass:0.6}}) driving scale and opacity, delay_i random 0-6 frames. Tagline opacity interpolate(frame,[9,15],[0,0.15],{easing:Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); corner shapes translateY via interpolate with Easing.out(Easing.cubic).

notes: Event window is very short (0.17-0.38 s); the logo assembly runs through f15. Part-by-part assembly uses many small diff boxes (b06, b07, b04); the whole wordmark b02 was chosen instead. The left-edge sliver b18 changes too but is too thin to identify, so it is left out.
